messages:
alex-cs: @eng fyi customer ticket #CS-2456 — invoice_lookup toolcalls started returning 'schema_validation_error: malformed_args' after we promoted model v3.3. Error shows invoiceId as number not string. anyone seen this?

Priya (Customer): It was working this morning, then started failing around 14:10. Sending minimal repro in the ticket.

alex-cs: attaching the exact request they used:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v3.3",
  "input": "Lookup invoice 123456",
  "tool": "invoice_lookup",
  "arguments": {
    "invoiceId": 123456
  }
}
```

Mike (SRE): quick logs: gateway returned 422 -> runtime: schema mismatch for invoice_lookup: expected string invoice_id, got integer. Also saw that the routing map changed in this rollout: invoice_lookup now maps -> invoices.fetch (maybe schema different).

Jordan (ML Eng): Probable cause: system prompt / few-shot examples include numeric IDs (eg. "invoice #1234") and the model now emits bare numbers for the arg. v3.3's instruction-following changes may have increased literal imitation of examples. Tool schema expects a string.

alex-cs: Repro steps from customer (copied from their ticket):
1) POST /chat/completions with system prompt (redacted)
2) user message uses a few-shot example: "Example: Find invoice 9876 -> call invoice_lookup"
3) model emits tool call with arguments {"invoiceId": 9876} (no quotes) and runtime rejects it.

Priya (Customer): attaching the serialized prompt & response in the ticket.

OpsBot: deployment redwood-v3.3 promoted at 2026-02-26T14:12Z

Mike (SRE): mitigation proposal: hotfix gateway to coerce ints -> strings for invoice_lookup at ingestion for next 24hrs. open PR and schedule rollback after regression.

Jordan (ML Eng): longer-term fixes: update instruction tuning to prefer quoted IDs in few-shot examples; add a strict output-parser that coerces types per tool schema with optional looser mode; add regression test to eval suite to catch schema drift caused by examples. Also add a console lint to warn when examples in a customer's system prompt don't match tool schema.

alex-cs: could the customer's system prompt be explicitly changing output format? i remember someone added a line that said "strip punctuation and quotes from ids" in a support case.

Jordan (ML Eng): yep, that would do it. system prompts that override formatting are a big risk. we should add a recommended clause in the tool docs: "Do not instruct the model to change quoting/formatting of tool args." and surface a warning in the Console if a workspace-level system prompt contains phrases like "remove quotes" or "strip punctuation".

Mike (SRE): created internal incident INC-789 and hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4567. applying gateway coercion now :hourglass: Will post deploy link.

alex-cs: actions:
- Mike: apply gateway coercion hotfix (in progress)
- Jordan: add parser coercion + regression test (CS-2456) and update model docs/examples
- alex-cs: confirm with customer whether temporary coercion okay or they want strict validation
I'll update ticket with these items.

Priya (Customer): temporary coercion is fine for now, prefer long-term fix. thanks. :thumbsup:

Jordan (ML Eng): adding telemetry alert to detect increase in 'tool_output_type_mismatch' for any tool. I'll push a PR by EOD and attach test vectors.

Mike (SRE): hotfix deployed to staging, rolling to prod in 10m. tagging eng-ml & devex.

alex-cs: thanks all — keeping CS ticket updated.
